caption: 01 · BRIEF — What is the design asking the pattern to do?. Record silhouette, balance, ease, movement, material behavior, size range, construction, finish, cost, time, accessibility, and the non-negotiable visual idea. A sketch alone rarely carries all of this.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what is the design asking the pattern to do? within The Patternmaker Behind the Designer.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 02 · JUDGMENT — Which decisions belong to the patternmaker?. Log the alteration, reason, evidence, person deciding, person approving, affected sizes and materials, and whether the change is technical, aesthetic, safety-related, or commercial. Skilled translation should remain attributable.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping which decisions belong to the patternmaker? within The Patternmaker Behind the Designer.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 03 · FIT — Whose body becomes the standard?. Identify the block, fit model or measurement source, sample size, grading method, movement test, wearer feedback, and excluded bodies. A technically repeatable pattern can still institutionalize a narrow body assumption.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping whose body becomes the standard? within The Patternmaker Behind the Designer.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 04 · RETAIN — Can the knowledge survive the specialist’s absence?. Preserve pattern version, annotation, toile images where permitted, fitting decisions, known failures, material constraints, maker credit, access rules, and a route for future questions. The file is evidence; narration explains the judgment.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping can the knowledge survive the specialist’s absence? within The Patternmaker Behind the Designer.
